act1.name: Iron Captain
act1.lore: Twenty years on the border under orders that never changed and relief that never came. He holds the line because the line is all the empire ever left him.

act1.name: Warchief
act1.lore: The border clans buried the old kingdom's treaties with the old kingdom, and answer the empire's new terms with none of their own.

act2.name: Knight Commander
act2.lore: First lance of the imperial second push. He wrote the cavalry doctrine the war colleges still teach, and has read the casualty tables it cost.

act2.name: Archmage
act2.lore: He keeps the ritual's middle pages and swears the summoning can still be steered. First of the court circle to say so, he has said it since long past the hour it could be.

act2.name: Dark Rider
act2.lore: Between the ritual sites he carries the court circle's sealed orders, and the roads empty ahead of him. The horse was black when this began; the rider has since outdone it.

act3.name: Blade Lord
act3.lore: The dueling halls' perfect product, kept by the empire the way one keeps a proof. Never touched in formal combat — and the sacred ground keeps no forms.

act3.name: Iron Wall
act3.lore: Held the breach at the old capital until the order to fall back rotted unread in a courier's bag. The empire made his stand its doctrine.

act3.name: Berserker King
act3.lore: Founder of the berserk school and its own cautionary tale, crowned by the acclaim of everyone too frightened to object. The corruption changed nothing in him.

act4.name: The Emperor
act4.lore: Traded the empire's future for the ritual's promise, and still reads the arithmetic as running in his favor.

finalBoss.name: The Lieutenant
finalBoss.lore: The ritual's first success, or its first casualty; the court circle's records use both. He has watched every future the seers walk, from the far side of the glass.

finalBoss.name: The Entity
finalBoss.lore: Older than the ground consecrated to keep it asleep. The ritual overfed it, and the war is the sound of it turning over. It does not hate. It does not need to.
